FavoritePod support

Need help with your library, local tools, or Drive sync? Start here, or send us the details.

Questions, bug reports, and feedback

rockyroadstudio@outlook.com

Include FavoritePod and Chrome versions, your operating system, what you tried, and what happened. Use sample URLs and redact private information in screenshots.

Save your first favorite

  1. Open a page in Chrome, click FavoritePod in the toolbar, and choose Add bookmark.
  2. The page is initially saved with its name and a preview when capture succeeds. Choose a folder, make any edits, and click Save.
  3. Choose Open launcher to see and organize your full library.

Closing the toolbar popup after the initial save keeps the new favorite. Use Delete in the bookmark form to remove it. To update a preview, reopen the page, use Add bookmark, then Refresh and Save.

Common questions

Do I need a Google account?

No. Saving, organizing, searching, and exporting your library work locally. A Google account is only needed if you choose Drive sync.

Why will a local file not open?

Open chrome://extensions, find FavoritePod, choose Details, and enable Allow access to file URLs. Confirm the original file still exists. On another computer, use Settings → Local files → File Locations Remap if the folder path differs.

Drive sync can transfer the saved link and preview; it does not copy the original file to another computer.

How do I connect or repair Google Drive sync?

Open Settings → Google Drive → Connect Google Drive, or use the launcher cloud button. Choose Sign in with Google and confirm your account. Connect each profile to the same account. If both libraries contain data, choose Merge local and Drive data to combine them.

If sync needs attention, check the connection, the account shown, and the sync status in Settings. Reconnect when asked to authorize again. If Drive is full, use Manage storage to free space, then try Sync now. Your local favorites remain available.

Does disconnecting delete my library?

No. Disconnect stops syncing only in the current Chrome profile. Local favorites and existing Drive data remain, and other connected profiles can continue. Account-wide revocation and Drive-data deletion are separate actions. See the privacy policy's deletion steps.

How do I back up or import bookmarks?

Go to Settings → Import & export. Export library produces a FavoritePod ZIP with previews. Export Chrome bookmarks produces HTML without previews. Import library accepts a FavoritePod ZIP; Import Chrome bookmarks accepts an HTML file exported by a browser.

Keep a backup before replacing a library or uninstalling. Choose the import mode carefully: replacing can overwrite the current local collection.

Why are there no frequently visited shortcuts?

Enable Frequently visited access under Settings → Behavior → Permission control and accept Chrome's optional Top sites permission. Also enable the visibility option for All favorites or your home page. Chrome determines the list; a new profile may have no sites yet.

Where is the right-click save option?

Enable Right-click save menu in Settings → Behavior and grant the permission. Right-click a page or link and choose Save to FavoritePod. Chrome restricts extension actions on some internal or protected pages.

Why is a preview missing or out of date?

A preview is a saved image, not a live webpage. Open the destination, invoke FavoritePod from the toolbar, and refresh the preview. Chrome may prevent capture on protected pages. In the launcher, you can also edit the favorite and upload an image.

How can I remove my data or ask a privacy question?

The privacy policy explains local storage, Drive data, recovery copies, and deletion. Email rockyroadstudio@outlook.com for help or to request deletion of support correspondence you supplied.

Reporting a problem

Please include the steps needed to reproduce the issue, what you expected, and the error text if one appears. Tell us whether the problem affects websites, local files, import/export, or Drive sync. Do not send Google passwords, access tokens, or a private backup. We will ask for a small, redacted example if needed.

Optional support for development

FavoritePod is free. If you would like to support development, visit Rocky Road Studio on Buy Me a Coffee. Contributions are voluntary and do not unlock features. Product help is available through the email above regardless of whether you contribute.
